info.title: ArgueBot API
info.description: Conversations, agents and execution for signed-in users. Data is shared within a tenant. Sign in with POST /v2.0/api/token or use a credential bearer token. The default administrator is admin@arguebot with password password and bearer token arguebotadmin; change them after the first sign-in.

RunnerProfile.description: An agent. CLI protocols are plain, claude, codex, gemini and mux. A CLI agent may name a stored secret in credentialId (a Claude Code token for claude, a Codex login for codex); select one when running in Docker or to override the credentials the program uses by default. model is optional for CLI agents and is passed as --model to Claude Code, Codex and Gemini, or into a literal {model} argument. Named CLI providers fill omitted name, executable and empty arguments on create/update from assets/harness-defaults.json. Claude Code includes --dangerously-skip-permissions; Codex and Mux include --yolo. Generic CLI (plain) requires an executable. CLI uses ordered arguments plus stdin. Mux defaults to print --yolo --output-format text --no-stats --no-session-persistence; custom arguments replace defaults. REST requires endpoint and model and supports native local tools (read_file, write_file, list_directory, run_process) when allowCli is enabled. workingDirectory applies to both runner kinds; empty uses the service directory. Tool activity is persisted as kind=tool messages, separate from answer text. secretEnvironmentVariable is a reference, never the secret itself. Profiles are frozen into relational snapshots for each run.
